items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: I mean Aretha sometimes did and some of these other young people like Jennifer Hudson does sometimes.

ctx.x: I think it's interesting that you talk about volume and playing really hard because you could say well play as loud as you want, we'll just pull the bar down of your volume but that's not how it works. You're still going to get loud playing softer. © Fillius Jazz Archive 8

Right. It's not the way these mics are perceived or even the way — you know one of the things about great vocalists you know they might be belters you know but they'll entice you into a song. They don't start out belting. Or some of them don't, I mean Aretha sometimes did and some of these other young people like Jennifer Hudson does sometimes. But — [there's a little traffic out here, I'm sorry]. But it's more like you're telling a story and even with your voice you're telling a story. And even with the violin…
Following their arc. I like that.
